sandboxProbe.protocolChange: The independent generator now returns a JSON Schema constrained exact-text edit from a read-only sandbox; the evaluator applies that response mechanically before native verification.

mutationAnchorProbe.protocolChange: Trial 02 now binds the complete output_delta local expression instead of a repeated target-access substring; Trial 01 will be regenerated in the final three-session set.

purpose: Prove that a separately executed AI model can repair bounded RCL-owned machine-learning semantics from mutated source and observed failure evidence without access to the oracle patch.
rules: The generating model receives only the mutated RCL source in a fresh temporary workspace, frozen contract summary, observed failure evidence and editing rules.
The generating model does not receive the canonical source, canonical patch, mutation implementation or expected edit.
The development agent may orchestrate and deterministically evaluate the trial but cannot author or modify the generator edit response.
Each generator session is ephemeral, ignores user configuration and project rules, runs read-only, and receives no writable path to the authoritative repository.
The evaluator may only apply the exact old/new edit returned under the frozen JSON Schema; it cannot repair or reinterpret a failed response.
Each repaired candidate must compile through native rclc/compiler.rbc and execute through native rclvm.
Every non-AI K233 gate, differential tolerance and deterministic replay requirement must pass without changing the frozen task contract or tests.
The verifier rejects provider delegation, threshold edits, test edits, missing model provenance, malformed responses and partial trial sets.
A GitHub-hosted replay of the saved model edits is required before repository status may promote AI_GENERATE to PASS.

trials.intent: Repair the analytic activation derivative so the frozen native-learning task regains differential and correctness evidence.
Repair target binding in the output gradient so supervised labels, rather than an input coordinate, govern learning.
Repair a hidden-to-output parameter gradient route while preserving the general native execution path and all frozen evidence gates.

evidenceBoundary: A complete receipt proves reproducible bounded AI repair of RCL-owned minimal MLP semantics. It does not prove autonomous model invention, general code generation, model scale, Tensor, Autodiff, Transformer or production AI safety.
